import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_66/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_66/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_66/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_66/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_66/training_4.csv"
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# All source tables have the same schema and match the target schema exactly,
# so we perform a UNION (concatenation) of all source tables.
Target4_66 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the column order and types match the target schema exactly
Target4_66 = Target4_66[['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']]

# Convert all columns to string type as per target schema
for col in Target4_66.columns:
    Target4_66[col] = Target4_66[col].astype(str)

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
Target4_66.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Since all sources have the same schema and the target schema is the same,
# the correct operation is to UNION all source tables (concatenate rows).

# require unique tuples by ['Nominee', 'Movie'].
# So we need to drop duplicates based on these keys to match the target.

# Keep columns exactly as target schema
